chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The day of justice will be severer on the oppressor than the day of oppression on the oppressed.
ai.seo_question: Why is justice harder for the oppressor than oppression was for the victim?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) highlights the asymmetry of divine retribution, noting that the oppressor's suffering on the Day of Judgment is more intense than the victim's endured during life. This concept is rooted in Shia exegesis, which interprets the 'weight' of justice as proportional to the magnitude of the power wielded by the oppressor, making their accountability heavier. It serves as a profound reminder that those in authority bear a greater burden of responsibility for their actions.
